title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — Schedule of Coverages by Package
content:
The HomeGuard Homeowners Policy is written in six packages. Each package fixes the coverage form, the basis on which personal property is insured and settled, the range of Coverage A dwelling limits it may be written at, and the size of the other coverages, most of them stated as a percentage of Coverage A. This schedule sets those figures side by side for every package.

## Schedule

| Coverage term | HO-3 Essential | HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 Premier | HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 Premier | HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coverage form | HO-3 | HO-3 | HO-3 | HO-5 | HO-5 | HO-5 |
| Coverage C peril basis | named perils | named perils | named perils | open perils | open perils | open perils |
| Coverage C loss settlement basis | actual cash value | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| Lowest Coverage A limit (USD) | 125000 | 150000 | 200000 | 250000 | 350000 | 750000 |
| Highest Coverage A limit (USD) | 450000 | 600000 | 850000 | 1000000 | 1500000 | 3500000 |
| Coverage B other structures (percent of Coverage A) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 20 |
| Coverage C personal property (percent of Coverage A) | 50 | 50 | 70 | 50 | 70 | 75 |
| Coverage D loss of use (percent of Coverage A) | 20 | 20 | 30 | 20 | 30 | 40 |
| Longest additional living expense period (months after a covered loss) | 12 | 12 | 24 | 12 | 24 | 24 |
| Extended replacement cost above Coverage A after a total loss (percent of Coverage A) | 0 (not included) | 0 (not included) | 25 | 0 (not included) | 25 | 50 |
| Coverage E personal liability limits available (USD) | 100000 or 300000 | 300000 or 500000 | 300000 or 500000 | 300000 or 500000 | 500000 or 1000000 | 500000 or 1000000 |
| Coverage F medical payments to others, per person (USD) | 1000 | 2500 | 5000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 |
| Ordinance or law coverage (percent of Coverage A) | 10 | 10 | 25 | 10 | 25 | 50 |

The column headings shorten the package names HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature.

## Reading the schedule

- **Coverage form.** The three HO-3 packages are written on the ISO HO-3 form and the three HO-5 packages on the ISO HO-5 form.
- **Coverage C.** On the HO-3 packages personal property is insured against named perils; on the HO-5 packages it is insured on an open-perils basis. HomeGuard HO-3 Essential is the only package whose personal property settles at actual cash value; every other package settles personal property at replacement cost.
- **Coverage A range.** Coverage A is written no lower than the package's lowest limit and no higher than its highest limit; both ends of the range are figures a package may be written at.
- **Percentages of Coverage A.** Coverage B, Coverage C, Coverage D, extended replacement cost and ordinance or law are each stated as a percentage of the Coverage A limit on the declarations.
- **Extended replacement cost.** A figure of 0 means the package includes no extended replacement cost; where the figure is above 0, it is the extra dwelling replacement cost payable above Coverage A after a total loss.
- **Coverage E.** The liability limits shown are the only limits the package may carry, listed from lowest to highest.

## Hypothetical illustration

The following figures are hypothetical and chosen only to show how the percentages read.

A HomeGuard HO-3 Premier policy is written with a Coverage A limit of 400000, which lies within that package's range of 200000 to 850000.

| Coverage | Percentage on HO-3 Premier | Resulting figure on a hypothetical Coverage A of 400000 |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage B other structures | 10 percent | 40000 |
| Coverage C personal property | 70 percent | 280000 |
| Coverage D loss of use | 30 percent | 120000 |
| Extended replacement cost after a total loss | 25 percent | 100000 |
| Ordinance or law | 25 percent | 100000 |

The same Coverage A of 400000 lies within the range of HomeGuard HO-5 Premier (350000 to 1500000) but below the lowest Coverage A limit of HomeGuard HO-5 Signature (750000), so it is not a limit HomeGuard HO-5 Signature may be written at.
